commit.message: publish Test Person 02 release evidence
harden rehearsal evidence and publish validation

keeper: the owner's cancel self-heals too — a killed job must not strand the exit

Same permanent-dedup flaw as the heartbeat path, found the same way: a
persona rehearsal issued a cancel, the keeper was restarted mid-job for a
deploy, and the cancel tx was already in seenHb — so the owner's exit
command was silently dropped forever, with the FXRP still in the vault.

Cancel now records an attempt (60s cooldown, 5 tries) and only marks the
tx seen once vault.cancel() actually lands on-chain. The owner's way out
is the last thing that may depend on a keeper staying up.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

rehearsal: honest copy for pre-existing and finished plans

Second persona run (EVM wallet, bound an already-settled plan) exposed two
misleading lines: the heartbeat step still promised "epoch >= 1" when an
existing plan actually needs the epoch to GROW during the rehearsal, and
nothing said that a finished plan cannot be rehearsed at all. Both now say
what the chain will actually do — including the baseline epoch to beat.

keeper: heartbeat proofs self-heal like funding proofs — no permanent dedup on failure

Caught live during a persona rehearsal: the beacon scan pushed the
heartbeat tx into seenHb BEFORE the proof ran, so one "request timeout"
stranded that heartbeat forever (the funding path learned this exact
lesson in e9fbbd4; the heartbeat path had kept the permanent dedup).
The hash now joins seenHb only on success — recorded by us or by a
faster crank — and failures retry with the same 60s-cooldown, 5-attempt
cap the funding scan uses.

rehearsal verdicts are structural now — a friendly refusal can no longer mint a receipt

External review caught a real P0 in the run sheet: the drill step matched
any journal event whose label said "blocked", so a BadState refusal on an
already-settled plan completed the "safety drill", and binding an old vault
auto-earned create/fund/heartbeat from history. Verdicts are now pure
functions over structured evidence, unit-tested (14 cases) and wired into CI:

- keeper: drill events carry drillStage / vaultState / reason and echo an
  optional sanitized run tag (?rh=…) the claim page passes through; every
  non-Active state gets its own honest sentence — including Cancelling,
  which is "funds still returning", NOT "settled"
- web: drillSatisfies requires kind=drill AND at>=run start AND vaultState=2
  AND reason=SilenceNotProven AND (untagged or tagged for THIS run); legacy
  label-only events never pass
- binding records a baseline {state, epoch, creationTs}; classifyRun splits
  fresh-plan (created after the run began) from existing-plan, shown on the
  page and stamped on the receipt; existing plans must GROW the heartbeat
  epoch during the rehearsal — history alone earns nothing
- copy: evidence claim corrected everywhere to 4 chain/keeper + 1 local
  wallet session + 2 self-attested; the drill is described as a live-chain
  staticCall recorded in the keeper journal (nothing broadcast on-chain);
  testnet reassurance scoped to Coston2/XRPL Testnet; faucet path now says
  to import the test-only account and never reuse its seed on Mainnet;
  receipt labelled participant-held with a share-deliberately note
- buidl pack: User validation moved INSIDE the Details fence so it cannot
  be dropped on copy; AI-simulated runs are explicitly barred from the
  pairs count in the operator note

rehearsal: every session write re-reads persisted state first

The evidence timer held a stale render's session and its read-modify-write
dropped a step completed in between (caught on the live walkthrough: the
poll's drill save overwrote the just-recorded Kit handover). All mutation
entry points — the poll, wallet auto-complete, bind, handover, debrief —
now start from loadSession(), so a concurrent tick can never lose steps.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

the rehearsal run sheet: a two-person, evidence-verified user drill (/rehearsal)

The Recovery Kit's "rehearse the claim once, together, today" becomes a
product surface. Seven steps for an owner-beneficiary pair — wallet,
create, fund, heartbeat, Kit handover, the early-claim drill, debrief —
where five checks flip ONLY on chain or keeper evidence (vault answers,
Active state, heartbeat epoch >= 1, the recorded on-chain drill refusal
newer than the run) and the two that cannot be verified are labelled
self-attested. Guided-flow patterns adapted from a sibling project:
steps as data, completion derived from verifiable state (never clicks),
run-scoped evidence so a previous run cannot advance a new one, cheap
resume from localStorage, explicit restart. Ends in a downloadable JSON
receipt — run id, per-step timestamps + evidence, total time, debrief
answers — the collectable proof behind "N pairs rehearsed unassisted".
Additive only: new route + an entry link on the landing page and the Kit.
